cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a starship data archive — standing; a domed planetarium lounge during an early stargazing breakfast — she breaks a round bread roll in half and studies the spiral of its crumb with quiet amusement before taking a bite; the boarding stairs of a small plane on a sunny airfield — pulls a hard-shell travel suitcase along behind her by its handle; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a quiet tidal observatory with a narrow saltwater wading basin — she draws a small circle in the damp salt crust on the rim of the basin; a cinema lobby with a popcorn counter — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a steel catwalk high inside a giant hangar — crouching down low; a retro-futurist home of rounded chrome appliances and soft panels — reclining on her back; a rocky waterfall pool under green trees — wrings out a towel between her hands; the upper floor of a busy roadside inn of the jianghu martial world — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — sitting on the ground; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — holds her keepsake at chest height; a Three Kingdoms festival street — holds a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by its cord at chest height
